div.div:
Functional Requirements:
Create a short url from a long url
optinally support the custom alias
optionaly support an expiration time
Be redirected to original url from the short url
Non Functional Requirements:
Low latency on redirects(~200ms)
Scale to 100DAu and 1B urls
Ensure uniqueness of the short code
High Availability eventual consistency

I am considering a 301 vs 302 redirects.
If we have requirements around collecting data for clicks and behaviour analytics collection I would go with the 302 else we can also explore 301 redirects.
One more thing is 301 is more useful when we have same routing for most of the URl here all new URI is mapped to new Actual URL so 301 might not make that better.
